payment_methods.name: Bank Transfer / IBAN (Direct)
payment_methods.instructions:
1. Transfer the exact amount in USD/EUR/GBP from your online banking app.
2. In the transfer reference/remarks, enter your Minecraft username.
3. Take a screenshot of the completed transfer confirmation.
4. Upload the screenshot and enter the Bank Reference / Transaction ID below.

payment_methods.name: EasyPaisa / JazzCash / Mobile Wallet
payment_methods.instructions:
1. Open EasyPaisa or JazzCash app.
2. Send exact order amount (Converted at current exchange rate PKR 280 / USD).
3. Enter your Order ID in remarks/purpose.
4. Take a clear screenshot of the successful transaction receipt.
5. Paste the TID (Transaction ID) and upload your screenshot.

payment_methods.name: PayPal Manual (Friends & Family)
payment_methods.instructions:
1. Send payment via PayPal to: payments@beastmc.net
2. IMPORTANT: Choose "Sending to a friend" (Friends & Family) to avoid delays.
3. Leave the PayPal note blank or enter your order code only. Do not mention Minecraft.
4. Save your PayPal Transaction ID and upload the receipt screenshot.

payment_methods.name: Crypto USDT (TRC-20)
payment_methods.instructions:
1. Send exact USDT amount to the TRC-20 wallet address above.
2. Ensure network chosen is TRON (TRC-20) to prevent loss of funds.
3. Wait for 1 network confirmation.
4. Copy the TxHash / Transaction Hash and upload a screenshot of your wallet withdrawal.
